title: Easy speaking in English – level 3
paragraphs: We have a website for you. Its name is www.speakinlevels.com. You can use filters to search for people at your level, by country, or by gender (female or male) and speak with them. You can also easily write to people via a form and you will be informed about new people who are ready to talk with you. There are also conversation topics and tips on how to start communication with new people.
We hope that you will find a lot of new friends for daily conversation in English and that this project will help you improve your English speaking skills!
